facts.text: Eastsound’s historic village, built in the 1880s, still showcases original homes and buildings that tell the island’s pioneer story.
The Orcas Island Historical Museum, located in Eastsound’s heart, hosts an annual Historical Day Fair and Parade each July and tours of historic B&Bs in spring.
The weekly newspaper The Islands' Sounder, founded as the Orcas Sounder in 1964, has its offices in Eastsound.
Eastsound’s walkable village bustles with galleries, boutiques, restaurants, cafes, and a history museum, making it a cultural hub for the island.
The Funhouse Commons, just north of Eastsound, offers kids interactive science, sports, and art exhibits, a pitching cage, and a climbing wall.
Eastsound’s public village green hosts a weekly farmers’ market, music performances, and community events on its lawn and outdoor stage.
